title: skeleton template variables
description: Values for templates/skeleton.md.j2 and templates/skeleton.html.j2. Field names match content/02-output-contract.xml; `description` on each property is the question put to the author.

owner.title: Owner
owner.description: Which developer owns the split and rename work, as role:handle (e.g. swe:alice)?

repo_url.title: Repo URL
repo_url.description: Which repository was audited, as its clone or web URL?

commit_sha.title: Commit SHA
commit_sha.description: Which commit did the audit run against (git rev-parse HEAD)?

source_root.title: Source root
source_root.description: Which directory is the source root the depth cap is measured from (e.g. src)?

line_limit.title: Line limit
line_limit.description: What per-file line limit does the audit enforce? Default 250, never above 300; must equal the number in CLAUDE.md.

audit_command.title: Audit command
audit_command.description: What exact command produced the audit (e.g. bash scripts/llm-arch-audit.sh src 250)?

largest_file.title: Largest file
largest_file.description: Which file is the largest above the limit, as a path?

largest_file_lines.title: Largest file lines
largest_file_lines.description: How many lines does that file have?

largest_file_split.title: Largest file split
largest_file_split.description: Into which named files does it split — data to src/data/, hooks to hooks/, pure functions to utils/?

import_lint.title: Import lint
import_lint.description: Which lint rule found the wildcard or namespace imports?

naming_score.title: Naming score
naming_score.description: What percentage of files pass every line of the naming rubric?

review_cadence.title: Review cadence
review_cadence.description: How often is the audit rerun and reviewed — monthly or quarterly?
